question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) right back
(C) fullback
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (right midfielder, right back, fullback)
1. Swap Alice and Claire: (fullback, right back, right midfielder)
2. Swap Alice and Claire: (right midfielder, right back, fullback)
3. Swap Bob and Claire: (right midfielder, fullback, right back)
Alice is the right midfielder, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
